items.quote: they recognized the voice of the young Levite; so they turned in there and asked him, “Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?” He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, “He has hired me and I am his priest.”
items.contrast: Micah, the person who hired, versus the young Levite, the person hired to be priest.
items.reason: The speaker is identified as the young Levite, and he says that Micah hired him and that he is Micah’s priest. The question clearly tests who received the role rather than who did the hiring.
